meaning.en: A box or case for a hat.
A box or case for carrying or storing a hat or hats.
meaning.vi: Hộp hoặc hộp đựng để đựng hoặc đựng mũ hoặc nón.

meaning.en: A piece of luggage for a hat; a case or box for a hat.
meaning.vi: Một kiện hành lý cho một chiếc mũ; hộp đựng hoặc hộp đựng mũ.

sentences.en: Women's pajamas come in a periwinkle organza hatbox and include a "Do Not Disturb" sign, a personalized gift card and a lavender-scented sachet.

sentences.en: Girls' pajamas come in a pink organza hatbox and include a door hanger that says "Chillin,'" a lavender scented sachet and a personalized gift card.

sentences.en: And, in an idle moment, he invented a method for lining women's hat-boxes!

sentences.en: One matching baby-blue Samsonite hatbox, containing my shoes, portable alarm clock, and toilet articles.

sentences.en: She begins by opening a colorful hatbox.

sentences.en: One metre of fabric is sufficient to cover the exterior of an 18-in-diameter hatbox.

sentences.en: There are vases of tulips and bowls of fruit, a bone china tea set and a stack of decorated hatboxes.
